item.title: Tapo’s new indoor security camera includes a touchscreen for video calls
item.description: TP-Link's Tapo smart home brand announced a new indoor security camera that can help keep an eye on your house while you're away or connect you to family and friends while you're at home. The C825 upgrades a 2K pan-and-tilt camera with a 4-inch touchscreen, so when it's not watching for intruders or misbehaving pets, it can be used to make hands-free video calls. The Tapo C825 is available starting today for $149.99. That's a little expensive for a 2K camera, but its tracking capabilities could make up for it not being 4K. Using a rotating base the C825 can pan 360 degrees while its camera module on top can tilt up and down up to 156 degree … Read the full story at The Verge.

item.title: Sterling given suspended sentence for dangerous driving
item.description: Former England footballer Raheem Sterling has been given a suspended sentence after admitting dangerously driving his Lamborghini while inhaling nitrous oxide from a balloon on a motorway. The 31-year-old, from Berkshire, who later crashed into a metal gate during rush hour, gave no reaction as he was handed a 12-months jail term, suspended for 18 months, at Basingstoke Magistrates' Court. Sterling had pleaded guilty to dangerous driving of a Lamborghini Urus and possessing nitrous oxide on the M25, the M3, the A327 and Minley Road on 28 May The judge said Sterling's use of the Class C drug had became a "maladaptive coping mechanism during a difficult period" in his career. Sterling, who left the court without making any comment, was ordered to complete 100 hours unpaid work and was banned from driving for 24 months. He was arrested after crashing near the M3 in Hampshire. Raheem Sterling - from national icon to suspended jail sentence District judge Kirsty Allman told the court on Wednesday that Sterling made a "deliberate and entirely selfish decision" to drive his vehicle "without adequate sleep" and whilst consuming nitrous oxide, commonly known as laughing gas. She said this exposed a "large number of road users to a significant risk of serious harm by the manner of your driving on two motorways and in peak travel time that morning". During the September hearing, prosecutor Simon Jones said a number of calls were made between 07:45 and 08:52 BST about a black sports car and the manner it was being driven. Witness Christopher Jennings called 999 after driving alongside Sterling's car on the M25, and "he was shocked by what he saw", Jones said, and made clear "he sighted the defendant inhaling from the balloon". Fiona Jennings – driving on the southbound M3 – described the driving as "absolutely horrendous" and "swerving in and out of lanes", the court heard. The court heard Sterling strayed into the central reservation of the M3, exited at junction 4A, and veered off the A327, crashing into a metal gate near a layby. His vehicle sustained "substantial damage to the tyres and bodywork and was no longer capable of being driven", the court heard. Sterling was taken to Basingstoke police investigation centre by officers, where he disclosed he had a "problem with nitrous oxide", said Jones. He complied with an impairment test, but for a blood sample, Sterling asked to obtain legal advice before making a decision. In the police sergeant's view "he was deliberately failing to provide a clear answer". Sterling was later interviewed by police with legal representation present where he accepted he had been the driver and provided no comment answers about the driving. Defending Sterling on Wednesday, Jason Bartfeld KC said there was no dispute that this was a "top category case" because of prolonged driving and "at times" serious impairment which would have been short periods within the driving. item.title: How soon can Giants’ Greg Newsome return from ankle surgery? We asked a doctor
item.description: Giants cornerback Greg Newsome will have surgery on his high right ankle sprain. So what does that so-called tightrope procedure entail, and how much time will Newsome miss as the 6-3-1 Giants push for an NFC East title in the final seven games? Well, Newsome will miss at least four weeks since he is now on injured reserve. Could he return immediately after that? That might be a stretch, according to Dr. Kenneth Jung , an orthopedic foot and ankle surgeon at Cedars-Sinai Orthopaedics and Sports Medicine in Los Angeles. Jung, who has not examined Newsome or his MRI results, also works as a foot and ankle consultant for the Rams. Newsome’s reported recovery window is four to six weeks, which could sideline him for the rest of the regular season — with a potential return coming in the playoffs. In his first season in New York, Newsome has become a crucial part of the Giants’ secondary, and his absence for any length of time will be a big blow. Jung called that window “a minimum” time frame. “These can take six to eight weeks to heal,” Jung told NJ.com on Tuesday. “There’s a lot of the soft tissue to heal.” With serious high ankle sprains like Newsome’s injury, the tibia and fibula separate just above the ankle joint, damaging the ligaments that connect the bones. “It’s a little more of a complex set of ligaments, compared to the low ankle sprain [ligaments],” Jung said. That’s why high ankle sprains take longer to heal than low sprains. Jung said a defensive back will require longer to recover from a high sprain, in general, than a lineman because of the nature of his position. As for the tightrope procedure, it involves putting a suture across the tibia and fibula to stabilize them. That type of surgery gained prominence in 2018, when Tua Tagovailoa — then at Alabama — had the procedure after suffering a high ankle sprain in the SEC title game on Dec. 1. He was able to return 28 days later and throw for four touchdowns in a national semifinal win. So why is it called tightrope surgery? “That’s the commercial brand name of the device that’s used,” Jung said. “It’s basically a suture device that you drill across the two bones. Then you insert this device in. “It’s got sutures and two metal buttons. Then when you pull the sutures, it actually squeezes the two bones together — and the buttons hold the bones in place.” With the device securing the bones, the ligaments are able to heal. “While having it in there, it adds stability to the high ankle sprain area,” Jung said. “It’s called a tightrope, but literally, we’re putting sutures across the two bones and then cinching them down.” MORE BY DARRYL SLATER Injured Giants starter needs surgery: Here’s how much time he’ll miss (UPDATE) Nov. 24, 2026, 6:43 p.m. As Giants get major news on starter injured vs. Jaguars, here’s how they’ll replace him Nov. 24, 2026, 12:40 p.m. Jung said a player would “push the envelope” by trying to return from this surgery before the six-week mark, as Tagovailoa did. “Is the

item.title: Drury’s Eckenroth earns at-large bid to cross country nationals
item.description: The NCAA announced its field for the 2026 Division II Cross Country National Championship Monday, Nov. 23, and Drury's Cera Eckenroth received an individual at-large bid to compete at Rim Rock Farm in Lawrence, Kansas, on Friday, Dec. 4. Eckenroth is the first Drury woman to qualify for the national meet since Bradley Weimer in 2022. Her bid marks the fifth national meet appearance by a Panther in DU women’s program history, as she joins Erin Dolan (2012), Claire McCune (2019, 2021) and Weimer. Eckenroth earned her bid with a ninth-place finish in 21:35.2 at the NCAA Midwest Regional on Nov. 21, up 13 spots from her 22nd-place finish a year ago. Two weeks earlier, she placed sixth at the Great Lakes Valley Conference (GLVC) Championships in 21:01.4, 5.4 seconds off the school's 6K record. The junior opened her season by winning the 5K at the Queen City After Dark in 17:06.0. She broke Weimer's program record of 17:23 by 17 seconds and finished 31 seconds ahead of the runner-up. She lowered her own record to 16:52.7 with a third-place finish at the Old Glory Gallop in Dallas. Eckenroth earned All-Region and All-GLVC honors for the second straight season, along with two GLVC Runner of the Week awards this fall. Bergum named GLVC Women’s Swimming Athlete of the Week Drury senior Gwen Bergum earned Athletic Solutions Great Lakes Valley Conference Women's Swimming Athlete of the Week following a strong overall performance against NCAA Division I competition at last weekend's SMU Invite in Dallas. Bergum established a new personal best with her win in the 200 breast — a race in which she claimed one of her two individual NCAA Division II national titles last spring — with a time of 2:10.43, which not only met the NCAA automatic qualifying standard, but also represents the third-fastest in Drury history. She also locked up a third-place individual finish in the 100 breast (1:00.94) and a seventh-place finish in the 200 IM (2:02.01).The Skedsmokorset, Norway native also helped Drury to a pair of impressive relay performances, including a fifth-place finish in the 400 medley and an eighth-place effort in the 200 medley.The GLVC honor is the second for Bergum, who earned the same honor on Jan. 20, 2026. This article originally appeared on Springfield News-Leader: Drury’s Eckenroth earns at-large bid to cross country nationals

item.title: Debian wakes up wearing Windows XP's actual skin
item.description: Win4Wine is one of the more remarkable and creative hacks we've read about in recent years. It runs Windows XP's genuine Explorer shell through patched Wine on Debian 13, with a custom window manager integrating Linux applications into the desktop. As its GitHub repository explains: "The taskbar, Start menu, desktop and folder windows are XP's real ones, and Linux applications get XP's frames and taskbar buttons." This impressive, possibly demented project has English installation instructions and a README, although its design documents are in Japanese. We found Mozilla's built-in translation handled those pretty well. Its developer goes by miKuta0407 on GitHub, their homepage , and X . Also note, you're going to need some Windows installation media for the full experience. The README says: "No Microsoft files are included. Only the files that are needed are extracted locally from your own ISO." It supports Windows XP Professional SP3 installation images in 32-bit Japanese or English editions, with an experimental option for Windows 7 SP1 x64. Without either Windows image, it can download and use ReactOS's free software shell instead, for what it terms "a Windows 2000-like classic look." In our view, that sounds much better anyway. Before any former Windows users cry hurray and reach for an optical drive, this is not some ready-to-run project. The top of the README warns: "This is a personal, experimental project, not a finished product for daily use." The developer has tested it only on a fresh Debian 13 installation and recommends a VM or spare machine, rather than an existing working desktop, which sounds like an excellent precaution to us. Also, before you ask, yes, it was vibe-coded with Claude. We found ourselves reminded of another crazy-but-is-it project that we wrote about back in January: What if Linux ran Windows... and meant it? Meet Loss32 . The Loss32 proposal was even more extreme. It suggested replacing essentially the entire Linux userland, so it would be a Linux kernel running Wine with a Windows desktop and Windows apps. However, Mikuta-san was way ahead of us – lower down, the README mentions and even links to Loss32. Saying that, since it launched at the end of 2025, the bottom of the Loss32 web page shows a couple of updates, reporting on delays in getting it working. That, to be honest, did not shock us, but we still admire the let's-do-this spirit. The developer also seems to have got slightly distracted by a previous project, touchHLE: high-level emulator for early iOS apps . Loss32, in turn, reminded us of Neptune OS, an attempt to give seL4 a Windows personality transplant . We wrote about that back in 2022, and work on it has continued: the project page shows updates in recent months. The team has also pushed out preview releases in 2022, 2024, 2025, and most recently in September. This OS face transplant also reminded us of our article, Classic 7 is Windows 10 LTSC cosplaying as Windows 7 . Some people really miss the

item.title: Oklahoma State “Happy” with 2027 Recruiting Class
item.description: Mark J. Rebilas-Imagn Images Oklahoma State head coach Eric Morris says he is happy with how the 2027 recruiting class looks just days before the Early Signing Period. The Cowboys are currently around the 45-46 spot in national rankings and sit at No. 8 in the Big 12 conference. Morris told reporters on Tuesday that he hopes to add a few more players before the deadline next Wednesday. The class has already built strong bonds because most of the commits visited campus during the season. Winning games helps the cause, and Boone Pickens Stadium offers a loud environment that recruits love. Morris admitted he usually dislikes in-season visits because coaches get too busy to talk with families. However, the team found a way to make those visits work well for everyone involved. Morris said in a press conference, according to Oklahoman , “Happy with where we’re at.” He added that the town and the game day experience impressed the visitors who came to see the team play. Why the Game Day Vibe Matters The atmosphere in Stillwater is a key reason players want to join the program. Morris noted that the reviews from families who took official visits were very positive. He believes the town and the stadium are major selling points for the recruits. “The one thing interesting is our game day experience is so good, and the town is something I’ve been so impressed with here,” Morris said. The positive feedback from these visits suggests the program is on the right track for future success. Kicker Sam Keltner Wins Big While recruiting is a top priority, the team also has big news on the field. Sophomore kicker Sam Keltner was named a finalist for the Lou Groza Award, which honors the nation’s best kicker. He joins two other finalists: Luke Drzewiecki from Minnesota and Nolan Hauser from Clemson. This season, Keltner has connected on all 50 extra points and 24 of his 25 field goal attempts. He leads the country with 122 total points, and his longest make came from 47 yards away. Morris thinks the numbers speak for themselves regarding Keltner’s chances. “If you look at the numbers with him, I think he’ll win the thing,” Morris said. The team celebrated the news by having Keltner give a speech to his teammates. Morris praised the kicker as a smart kid who will be successful after his playing career ends. Player Health and Injury Updates The team also received good news about receiver Miles Coleman, who left a recent game against Arizona State after a hard hit. Safety Adrian Wilson was ejected for targeting, but Coleman is expected to play in the final regular season game against Kansas. Morris described the receiver as tough and said he is practicing normally. “Tough as nails … Miles is just fine,” Morris said. The coach added that Coleman is running around and making plays just like he always does. item.title: Roger Goodell Releases Emotional Statement Following Death of Martha Firestone Ford
item.description: The Detroit Lions organization is mourning the loss of one of the most influential figures in franchise history. On Tuesday night, the Lions announced that Martha Firestone Ford had passed away at the age of 101. Following the heartbreaking announcement, the Detroit Lions released an emotional statement honoring Mrs. Ford and her decades of dedication to the organization. NFL Commissioner Roger Goodell and his wife, Jane Goodell , also released a joint statement Tuesday night, paying tribute to the longtime Lions matriarch. Martha Firestone Ford stands on the sidelines before the Detroit Lions game against the Cincinnati Bengals on Sunday, Oct. 17, 2021, at Ford Field. (via Reuters Connect) Roger Goodell Pays Tribute to Martha Firestone Ford In a statement released by the NFL , the Goodells remembered Mrs. Ford for her commitment to her family, the Detroit Lions, and the city she loved. They also recognized the integrity with which she and her late husband, William Clay Ford Sr. , led the franchise. “Martha was special. She cared so deeply about her family, the players, their fans, and the city of Detroit. She was committed to making the Lions – and the game of football – better. Martha and her husband, William Clay Ford, led the franchise with dignity and integrity. We will miss her kindness and sweet sense of humor. We extend our deepest condolences to her children, the entire Ford family, and the Lions’ organization.” The statement also highlighted Mrs. Ford’s dedication to improving the game of football, her kindness, and her sense of humor. The Goodells concluded by extending their condolences to the Ford family and the entire Lions organization. An Emotional Thanksgiving Awaits the Detroit Lions As reported by NFL.com , Mrs. Ford assumed control of the Lions in 2014 before passing principal ownership to her daughter, Sheila Ford Hamp , in 2020. Despite stepping away from that role, she remained involved with the organization and continued attending games during the 2026 season. Her passing comes just two days before the Lions host the Chicago Bears in their annual Thanksgiving Day game at Ford Field. What is already one of Detroit’s most cherished football traditions will undoubtedly carry additional emotional significance this year. Our thoughts and prayers are with the Ford and Firestone families and the entire Detroit Lions organization during this difficult time. Rest in peace, Mrs. Ford.

item.title: Fury vs Joshua fight to go ahead despite objections over 3am finish
item.description: The all-British heavyweight fight is due to take place on 11 December [Getty Images] Councillors have approved plans allowing December's highly anticipated Tyson Fury v Anthony Joshua fight in Cardiff to finish in the early hours. Fans in hospitality boxes at the Principality Stadium will be allowed to drink alcohol until 03:00, with the venue closing at 03:30, to align with prime time viewing in the US. Members of Cardiff Council's Licensing Sub Committee were told 130 police officers would help maintain order at the event on 11 December, with twice the number of stewards present compared to a regular sports event. A handful of residents had objected to the proposed late finish , raising concerns over noise, antisocial behaviour and public safety, but none came to the meeting. Councillors were told the event was a "big deal for the city" and would boost the Welsh capital , in terms of "revenue" and "profile." Huw Thomas, chief inspector with South Wales Police, said the challenge for officers was the length of the programme, compared with other events in the stadium, saying the fight was begin viewed by the force as a "three-day event". On Wednesday, the council meeting was told 450 out of the 1600 stewards present on the night would be dedicated to fans seated on the pitch area of the stadium. Mark Williams, Stadium Director at the Principality Stadium, said the ring walk would take place at 01:00 GMT on 12 December, with the fight expected to start at 01:30. Regarding tickets, he said there were still tickets available, but they were "expecting a capacity of 77,000, if everything sells". The boxing rivals are expected to contest the WBA 'super' heavyweight title [Getty Images] Councillors heard objectors had raised "legitimate concerns", but measures had been put in place to mitigate them. Plans for more trains in the early hours of Saturday were outlined, to support spectators getting home after the fight. In response to concerns over noise, the meeting was told "no external PA system would be used" and noise would be "monitored" on the night. Councillors heard initial plans to have live music before the fight would not happen but national anthems would be sung. Regarding alcohol, councillors were told the application was for a "modest two-hour extension on the licence for one night only" and that approximately 10-15 venues were planning to open after hours for fans. Breathalysers would be used on the gates but only for those, "who look worse for wear", according to Williams. After a short period of consideration, chair of the committee, Grace Ferguson-Thorne, said the panel had agreed to grant permission, describing the measures taken - including the stewarding levels and the closure of the roof - as "really reassuring". While early-hour finishes require extensive co-ordination around transport, policing and crowd management in the city centre, the venue already holds a precedent for late-night boxing. item.title: ‘To the moon’ – Blake Griffin hilariously calls out NBA owners over rising ticket prices
item.description: Photo by Ethan Miller/Getty Images Blake Griffin tackled the recent surge in NBA ticket prices and the overall challenge of being able to watch games for fans. As the NBA continues to earn record-setting revenues with each passing season, the league’s fanbase has perhaps been the most neglected group. New streaming deals that make viewing games on television more unaffordable, combined with the drastic rise in ticket prices, have left NBA fans incredibly frustrated with the product. Blake Griffin suggests NBA owners are driving up ticket prices and viewing costs for personal gain Speaking on ‘The Steppback,’ Blake Griffin tackled the issue of rising costs of enjoying NBA games, both in the arenas and on television. He suggested that the team owners benefit from massive subsidies and an exemption from antitrust laws, thus allowing them to raise prices at the expense of the fans. “You know your prices are too high when the guy wearing $500 of authentic Yankees merch says, ‘Your prices are too high,’” Griffin joked on his show. “And let’s not forget that America’s sports teams at large have received over $30 billion in subsidies for their stadiums and arenas. “So to recap: the teams have a legal exemption to antitrust laws, billions in local subsidies, ticket prices are shooting to the moon, and we still can’t watch the games we want on TV for a price that most people can afford. It’s getting so bad it’s even making bad guys look good. You know… Senator Grayson Allen has a point.” The issue of rising costs associated with being an NBA fan has been a massive issue for several years now. What once used to be an affordable product for people of all ages has now become a luxury good that only the most passionate of fans would be willing to part with the amount of money required to consume the product. Unfortunately, there seems to be no push from NBA owners or Commissioner Adam Silver to try and address this issue. If anything, some owners even relish the opportunity to raise the prices to capitalise on the willingness of fans to pay. item.title: Chris Johnson And Jeff Hafley Demand Answers On Missed Call
item.description: Credit: Sam Navarro-Imagn Images The Dolphins lost 26-9 on Sunday, but the final score tells only part of the story. A specific moment in the second quarter has left Miami players and staff furious. Rookie cornerback Chris Johnson and head coach Jeff Hafley both believe a clear penalty was missed against Josh Allen. Johnson was thrown to the ground by Allen, who had grabbed his facemask during the missed call. Johnson stated during a Zoom media session on Tuesday that he was “Definitely surprised there was no flag thrown.” The View From the Sideline Johnson explained the sequence of events that led to the scuffle. He noted that he saw Jacob Rodriguez secure the interception before moving to block. “I saw J-Rod get the pick and from there on, I’m looking for a block,” Johnson said, according to the Palm Beach Post . “It just happened to be Josh Allen. I guess he didn’t appreciate it much. And then we got tied up a bit.” Johnson believes the contact crossed a line that should have triggered an immediate penalty. He feels that grabbing a player by the helmet usually results in a flag. “Once you get into another player’s helmet it’s usually a flag,” Johnson said. The lack of a penalty call on this play was one of many missed calls that hurt the Dolphins during the 26-9 loss. Hafley’s Frustration With Officials Head coach Jeff Hafley shared the same frustration as his rookie player. He confirmed that he saw the play and knew his team was upset about the missed call. “I saw it and our guys saw it because they were upset and then they started to talk and I said, I’ll handle it,” Hafley said. Hafley then spoke directly to the referees about the incident. The coach expressed confusion over why the officials did not penalize the roughness. He stated he does not understand how the play was not called a penalty. “And then I asked the refs. I’m not going to get into sending it to the league and everything that happened. I just, I don’t understand how that is not a penalty,” Hafley said. He argued that whatever the play was called, it warranted a 15-yard penalty and a spot change. The Cost of a Missed Call The failure to call the penalty had a direct impact on the field position and the game flow. Rodriguez secured an interception, after which the Dolphins lost 12 yards across three plays until Daniel Carlson successfully kicked a 52-yard field goal. This sequence cut Miami’s deficit to 20-6. A proper penalty would have placed the ball at the Buffalo 11-yard line, a much more dangerous spot for the Bills defense. Josh Allen finished the game with 304 passing yards and two interceptions in the victory. He did not attempt a single rush, likely to save energy for the upcoming Thanksgiving game against the Kansas City Chiefs. The Dolphins will face the New York Jets again on Sunday, November 29, at Hard Rock Stadium and won’t face the Bills again until January 3. item.title: Raheem Sterling - from national icon to suspended jail sentence
item.description: Raheem Sterling has scored 123 goals in 396 Premier League appearances and provided 65 assists [Getty Images] Raheem Sterling grew up a stone's throw from Wembley Stadium, and went on to start a European Championship final for England there. At his peak, the four-time Premier League winner was earning £325,000 a week at Chelsea. "Raheem is a huge player with a huge influence in the last few years in English football," said then Blues boss Thomas Tuchel when he signed a 27-year-old Sterling in a £50m deal in 2022. "He is at the perfect age to take responsibility around the younger players that we have and be an example. "He just needs to do what he did over the last few years and he will be a huge asset for us." Sterling enjoyed a 10-year England career, also played for Liverpool, Manchester City and Arsenal, and commanded combined transfer fees of about £100m. But his career at the top level looks to be in the balance at the age of 31 after he was handed a 12-month prison sentence, suspended for 18 months, for dangerous driving. Sterling has also been disqualified from driving for two years and ordered to carry out 100 hours of unpaid work. At an earlier hearing in September, Sterling admitted dangerous driving on a motorway before crashing a Lamborghini on 28 May. The crash caused "substantial" damage to his car and all four wheels, which prevented him from driving further, the court heard. Sterling also admitted possessing nitrous oxide for wrongful inhalation, and failing to provide a specimen for analysis. A stark warning aged 10 Sterling's life was touched by tragedy at a young age. Born in Kingston, Jamaica, he was just two when his father was shot dead. His mother, Nadine, was determined to give her children a safer environment to live in. She moved to England to lay a path for Sterling and his sister to join her once she had found a home and finished her education, while cleaning bathrooms and changing bedsheets in hotels to earn extra money. Sterling grew up on a housing estate in Neasden, north-west London, and spent part of his education at Vernon House, where teachers attempted to help the football-obsessed youngster with behavioural problems. In an interview with the Players' Tribune in 2018, Sterling said: "I was so naughty that they kicked me out of primary school. I just didn't like to listen to anyone but my mum. That was my problem." He was 10 when teacher Chris Beschi told him: "If you carry on the way you're going, by the time you're 17 you'll either be playing for England or in prison." Sterling would grow to become one of the standout English attacking talents of his generation. Raheem Sterling: From school struggles to a class of his own On 14 November 2012 - aged 17 years and 342 days - Sterling made his England debut on the night his Liverpool captain Steven Gerrard won his 100th cap in a 4-2 defeat by Sweden in Stockholm. item.title: 'We are going to Arsenal now' - Thibaut Courtois warns Real Madrid not to 'get carried away' after PSV scare
item.description: Real Madrid C.F. v PSV Eindhoven - UEFA Champions League 2026/27 League Phase MD5 - Getty Images Sport Real Madrid goalkeeper Thibaut Courtois has urged his teammates to stay grounded following their 5-1 Champions League victory over PSV Eindhoven on Tuesday night. Despite the emphatic final scoreline, the Belgian shot-stopper highlighted a dismal first-half performance that nearly saw the Spanish giants fall into a significant deficit. Madrid run riot after shock Perisic opener Madrid staged a ruthless second-half comeback to crush PSV and maintain their flawless record. Los Blancos were initially stunned before the interval when veteran Ivan Perisic converted from the penalty spot to hand the Dutch side a shock half-time advantage. Prompted into immediate action, the Madrid bench rolled the dice with a decisive triple substitution at the break—a gamble that paid immediate dividends as Federico Valverde slotted home the equaliser before half-time introducee Jude Bellingham unleashed a sensational long-range strike to turn the match on its head. With the momentum firmly in their favour, Madrid’s superstar attack shifted into overdrive and tore through a tiring PSV backline. Kylian Mbappe showcased his trademark penalty-box poaching with two close-range finishes to put the contest well beyond doubt, before Vinicius Junior capped off the five-star rout. Having already been denied by the woodwork in both halves during a lively display, the Brazilian winger finally got his deserved reward late on, tucking away a composed finish to seal an emphatic statement victory. Eyes top-eight seal against Gunners While Los Blancos managed to turn things around after the break, Courtois was brutally honest in his post-match assessment, immediately shifting his focus to a pivotal clash in North London that could seal their place in the Champions League's top eight. Speaking to Ziggo Sport , as quoted by NOS , shortly after the final whistle, Courtois looked ahead to the looming test against the Gunners while highlighting a recurring flaw in Madrid's mentality. "We are going to Arsenal now, that is a difficult match. If we win there, we are reasonably certain of a top-eight finish. It is especially important that we don't get carried away, because that is often our problem," Courtois stated. Delivers blunt warning after PSV scare Courtois was forced into several key interventions to keep the score manageable in tje first half. He delivered a blunt assessment of Madrid’s defensive fragility after being forced into a string of crucial saves to keep his side afloat. The Belgian shot-stopper pulled no punches following the final whistle, warning his teammates that Los Blancos simply cannot afford to repeat such sloppy errors as their European campaign intensifies. "Our first half was not good," Courtois admitted. "PSV had a few clear chances. We could just as easily be 0-3 down. At half-time, the coach brought us back down to earth. item.title: Travis Kelce Reflects on Playing in 100th Game at Arrowhead Stadium with Sweet Nod to Wife Taylor Swift
item.description: Travis Kelce and Taylor Swift. Credit: Brooke Sutton/Getty; Jamie Squire/Getty NEED TO KNOW Travis Kelce celebrated his 100th regular-season home game at Arrowhead Stadium, reflecting on his 14-season legacy there He recalled seeing Taylor Swift perform her Eras Tour at Arrowhead months before their relationship became public Swift attended Sunday’s game with her family, celebrating as Kelce scored a touchdown in the Chiefs’ big win Travis Kelce is taking a sweet stroll down memory lane after playing in his 100th regular-season home game at Arrowhead Stadium on Sunday, Nov. 22. Reflecting on the NFL milestone during the Wednesday, Nov. 25 edition of his New Heights with Jason & Travis Kelce podcast , the star Chiefs tight end, 37, spoke about his 14-season legacy at Arrowhead, noting he’s not only played in front of the home Kansas City crowd, but also got to see his wife, Taylor Swift , perform her blockbuster Eras Tour. “100 Games, dude, it feels pretty awesome right now,” Travis told his older brother and co-host, Jason Kelce . “To think about that legacy of that stadium, man, and it’s pretty crazy to think they’re moving on from that stadium, because of all the history that’s happened over the years and history of the franchise and everything. You know it’s been home for me for 14 years, and it’s been one of my favorite places to go to play and to watch not only football, but musical events, and I’ve had so much history and so many things that mean so much to me happen at Arrowhead that a hundred games, it’s pretty awesome to hit that milestone.” 100 games at Arrowhead had Travis going down memory lane NEW EPISODE OUT NOW!!! pic.twitter.com/qfBSY7F9ML — New Heights (@newheightshow) November 25, 2026 A third-round pick out of Cincinnati in 2013, Travis has spent his entire NFL career with the Chiefs and has won three Super Bowls with the franchise. Months before he hoisted the Lombardi Trophy for the third time in February 2024, he saw Swift, 36, perform her Eras Tour at Arrowhead in July 2023 and playfully joked on the podcast about how he failed to give her a friendship bracelet with his phone number on it. The rest, as they say, is history. Swift attended her first Chiefs home game in September 2023, and the couple stepped out together publicly a month later in New York City. Travis Kelce during the Chiefs’ home game on Sunday, Nov. 22, 2026. Credit: Scott Winters/Icon Sportswire via Getty Swift and Travis announced their engagement two years later in August 2025, and tied the knot at Madison Square Garden in July. The pop superstar, who has frequented Chiefs home games in recent years, attended Sunday’s game, along with her parents, Scott and Andrea Swift , mother-in-law Donna Kelce , sister-in-law Kylie Kelce and her nieces , Wyatt, 7, and Finn, 19 months. Swift sweetly embraced Wyatt after Travis scored a touchdown against the Arizona Cardinals in the Chiefs’ 34-7 win. Taylor Swift performs at Arrowhead Stadium in July 2023. Credit: John

item.title: US army to detonate stockpile of unstable bomb-making chemicals in Iowa
item.description: The US military will on Wednesday detonate some 10,000 pounds of unstable and degraded explosive material in Iowa, where local residents were urged to evacuate amid concerns over possible toxic lead contamination. US officials say the 68 drums of lead azide are at risk of spontaneous explosion. A series of safety measures are being taken to curb potential contamination from the blast, but the Army has encouraged residents of a small town and other nearby areas to leave "out of an abundance of caution."

item.title: The forgotten victims of femicide: Children orphaned by violence in Italy
item.description: November 25th is International Day for the Elimination of Violence Against Women. The forgotten victims of femicide are the children who find themselves motherless, often because their mother was killed by their own father. Italy recorded 97 female homicides in 2025 – 62 of them were committed by a partner. These crimes leave whole families devastated and children who have to grow up without their parents. FRANCE 24’s correspondent in Italy, Natalia Mendoza, reports.

item.title: Teams, media, fans share tributes to former Detroit Lions owner Martha Ford
item.description: GLENDALE, ARIZONA - SEPTEMBER 08: Lions team owner Martha Ford waves to fans prior to the NFL football game between the Detroit Lions and Arizona Cardinals at State Farm Stadium on September 08, 2019 in Glendale, Arizona. (Photo by Ralph Freso/Getty Images) | Getty Images On Tuesday night, the Detroit Lions announced that former team owner and Chair Emeritus Martha Firestone Ford passed away at the age of 101 . With such an accomplished life and so many lives touched, it’s not surprising that there was an outpouring of love from Mrs. Ford online after the news broke. Many teams, media members, former players, and even fans shared their interactions and thoughts about her. Here’s a sampling of them. NFL teams honor Martha Firestone Ford Ford was one of the few female figureheads leading an NFL team. So a few other women in leadership roles around the NFL talked about her being a trailblazer in the business. Here’s Titans owner Amy Adams Strunk: From Titans controlling owner Amy Adams Strunk: "Martha was an inspiration to so many of us throughout the NFL, leading with courage and conviction. For more than six decades, she embodied the very best of what it means to be a steward of our game. Her tireless dedication to the… https://t.co/8weV8jSSSl — Tennessee Titans (@Titans) November 25, 2026 Saints owner Gayle Benson : “I am deeply saddened to learn of the passing of Martha Firestone Ford. Mrs. Ford was a true matriarch of the National Football League and an extraordinary pillar of the Detroit community for more than six decades. Having stepped into the role of principal owner following the loss of her beloved husband, I deeply admired the grace, strength, and unwavering dedication with which she led the Detroit Lions. She paved the way for women in sports ownership and set an enduring standard for leadership, philanthropy, and devotion to family. On behalf of the entire New Orleans Saints organization, I extend my heartfelt prayers and deepest condolences to Sheila, Martha, Bill, Elizabeth, and the entire Ford family, as well as the Detroit Lions organization during this difficult time.” Jane Goodell, wife of NFL commissioner Roger Goodell, offered this joint statement with her husband: Jane Goodell and NFL Commissioner Roger Goodell tonight released the below statement regarding the passing of Detroit Lions Owner/Chair Emeritus Martha Firestone Ford: https://t.co/z8sumgw2FJ pic.twitter.com/EFumKHEfNo — NFL (@NFL) November 25, 2026 And here are some other teams who offered official statements: pic.twitter.com/tbcf2QzVAx — Las Vegas Raiders (@Raiders) November 25, 2026 A statement from Michael Bidwill on the passing of Martha Firestone Ford. pic.twitter.com/tTMEirx0b2 — Arizona Cardinals (@AZCardinals) November 25, 2026 https://t.co/MpMs0lM9li pic.twitter.com/CjDZgbh2ml — Miami Dolphins (@MiamiDolphins) November 25, 2026 Statement by The Glazer Family regarding the passing of Martha Firestone Ford: We are saddened to learn of the passing of Martha F

item.title: ACC Roundup – Pitt, Notre Dame Impressive
item.description: PHILADELPHIA, PENNSYLVANIA - NOVEMBER 08: Head coach Jeff Capel of the Pittsburgh Panthers signals to his players in the second half during a college basketball game against the Penn State Nittany Lions at The Palestra on November 8, 2026 in Philadelphia, Pennsylvania. (Photo by Mitchell Layton/Getty Images) | Getty Images In Tuesday’s ACC Action, Notre Dame beat Central Michigan 88-70, Clemson nearly came back to beat Washington before losing, 64-63, Samford beat Georgia Tech, 92-81, Pitt took care of Oklahoma, 79-68, TCU knocked off Miami, 84-71, Florida State trashed UNC Asheville, 97-61, Colorado nipped Stanford, 70-65, and Louisville beat Texas Tech 72-64. Clemson fell behind 19-5 in the first half, and it looked very much like the Ole Miss game had on Monday night. But give the Tigers credit: they fought back and nearly pulled off a superb comeback. Ace Buckner led a 13-4 run over the last 4:21, and Buckner had a chance to win the game, but his layup was blocked. Even so, Clemson showed a lot more in this one than they did against Ole Miss. Buckner is playing about as well as he can, but Clemson is asking too much of him. He needs some help. Pitt played pretty well against Jeff Capel’s old team, ripping off a 13-3 run, and then a 10-0 run to go up by 17. Ultimately, the Panthers took a 36-24 lead at the half. Pitt hit six straight threes early in the second half to push the lead out to 23. Oklahoma eventually cracked down defensively and held Pitt without a basket for 7:18, but the Panthers finished the Sooners off from the foul line. Baye Ndongo continues to play well with 16 points and 10 rebounds, and his old Georgia Tech teammate, point guard Naithan George, had 14 points and 9 assists. A’lahn Sumler had 21 points to pace the Panthers. With the win, Pitt moves to 7-0, for its best start since 2013-14. TCU upset Miami, and their shiny new toy, Robbie Avila, had a big impact. Avila forced Miami’s bigs outside more than Jai Lucas would have liked, and Somto Cyril, who is pretty exclusively an inside force, fouled out with 12 minutes to go. Malik Reneau is back for the ‘Canes, but it didn’t much matter. Louisville and Texas Tech had a close, tough first half, with the Birds taking a 26-25 lead into halftime. The second half was a different story. Seth Trimble and Karter Knox led a 22-13 run. The Red Raiders hung around and made it interesting, but ultimately, the Cardinals held on for the win. Keep in mind that Texas Tech is still without JT Toppin as he recovers from an ACL injury, and freshman big man Bassala Bagayoko is out with an injury too. The Central Michigan Chippewas played well in the first half, going up 15-10, and down just 39-38 at the half. In the second half, though, Braeden Shrewsberry went off for 18, finishing with a career-high 29, leading the Irish on an 18-5 run. Notre Dame got 27 points in transition, which is pretty solid. The Irish are now 7-1, which is the best start Notre Dame has had since 2016-17, when Mike Brey

item.title: Russell Wilson says young NFL QB is already reminding him of Lamar Jackson
item.description: Photo by Candice Ward/Getty Images Lamar Jackson has had a season to forget with the Baltimore Ravens, with injuries hamstringing his 2026 season. Amid his issues, Russell Wilson has admitted there’s a young quarterback already reminding him of the Ravens star. There is an art to being a mobile quarterback, and that is something Wilson knows very well following his time with the Seattle Seahawks. Wilson was one of the most elusive quarterbacks the NFL has ever seen, with Jackson providing a whole different level of agility after being drafted in the 2018 draft. A number of players have since entered the league, adopting the style of a mobile quarterback. Jayden Daniels is one who has particularly impressed Wilson despite enduring his own struggles with the Washington Commanders. Russell Wilson claims Jayden Daniels reminds him of Lamar Jackson Since his rookie season in 2024, Daniels has been unable to avoid injuries hindering his career. This year has not been quite as bad as last, but the quarterback has missed a couple of Commanders games. His stats, however, have been impressive. “What Jayden Daniels did last night, the clutch gene that he had in that moment, took me back to his rookie year when he was healthy and the confidence that he had. I think the biggest thing with Jayden is that level of confidence, that know-how, and that ability to step up and rip the football. He can do it all,” Wilson said on the Set Hut show. “When you think about somebody who runs the football to the pace that he can run with, he reminds me of RG3 when he was a young rookie before he got hurt: that ability to run, he could score at any moment. I also think about a guy like Lamar Jackson with the ability to run like that, but he throws the ball. Him and Caleb Williams, they’ve got great arms. They can throw the ball at any point, at any position on the field. I think that’s the thing that was evident this past game, especially those last two throws of the game.” Wilson spoke about Daniels’ ability to be ‘clutch’ in the moments when the game is on the line; that has taken some work this season after the shambolic ending to the game against the New York Giants. What is worth pointing out is that Daniels has only thrown two interceptions during his eight games this season. Not turning the ball over is something that is priceless to NFL head coaches, with Daniels’ touchdown-to-interception ratio seriously impressive. Bo Nix was heavily praised for keeping Denver in manageable positions despite not necessarily having anywhere near the number of touchdown passes as someone like Joe Burrow. Daniels has shown a lot of ability, which is noted by Wilson, but his ability to keep the football out of harm’s way is perhaps even more impressive. item.title: Current verbal commitments new FSU head coach Glenn Schumann should prioritize keeping
item.description: ATLANTA, GA - NOVEMBER 25: Georgia Bulldogs Co-Defensive Coordinator Glenn Schumann signals in a play during the college football game between the Georgia Bulldogs and the Georgia Tech Yellow Jackets on November 25, 2023, at Bobby Dodd Stadium in Atlanta, GA. (Photo by Jeffrey Vest/Icon Sportswire via Getty Images) | Icon Sportswire via Getty Images Recruiting never stops, and now that Glenn Schumann has been hired as FSU’s new head coach , one of his first tasks will be evaluating the current crop of prep verbal commitments and deciding which ones to try keeping in the fold. Regardless, expect for FSU to bring in a small number of prep signees in December primarily based on how quickly they can contribute. At the time of publication, Florida State’s 2027 recruiting class is ranked 58th in the nation with a mere 14 commitments, only five of them ranked as blue-chips. Several commitments have already reopened their recruitments while a vast majority should be described as tenuous at best. Which prospects should Schumann prioritize for retention? The first call S Ta’Shawn Poole Poole rhymes with jewel, and that’s exactly what he is in this year’s recruiting class. Coincidentally, Georgia was among the finalists for Poole. He is the only commit in the class with demonstrated NFL upside and is a legitimate top-100 prospect (I’d personally have him top-75). Poole is the first call Schumann needs to make and will see the field sooner than later, dependent on how quickly he learns the scheme. Poole has racked up 49 tackles and four interceptions despite rarely being targeted, and he’s caught 39 passes for 828 yards (21.2 yard avg) and 13 touchdowns to go with 30 carries for 130 yards and three more TDs. Prioritize these guys LB/S Jernard Albright Albright had a recent flirtation with Alabama and I’m still not sold on his prior statement about being 100% shut down, but he is a nice piece for the LB room. Albright has a background playing safety but Ernie Sims sold him on playing LB, and Albright looks like he’ll be able to make the transition. He’s having a strong senior season with 88 tackles (6 for loss), 13 QB hurries, two sacks, two interceptions, a forced fumble, and a recovery. He even has 10 kickoff returns for 448 yards, showcasing his athleticism. DL Sam LeJeune Schumann knows the importance of both lines, and LeJeune is FSU’s top commitment along the DL. He’s 6’4, 280, is a power lifter, and shows good leverage. He doesn’t possess ideal length but my favorite part about his game is his persistence- he never takes a play off and routinely chases down ball carriers when others give up. He has 42 tackles (17 for loss, which is great to see), two sacks (which is disappointing), five pass breakups, and a ridiculous five blocked kicks (10 in the past two seasons). He’d be a nice rotational piece along the interior DL, where FSU needs to stack depth for Schumann’s schemes. WR Sean Green It’s always nice to inherit a dual weapon at wide receiver and sp

item.title: Liverpool ready to hand Barcelona a Ronald Araújo reality check
item.description: Liverpool ready to hand Barcelona a Ronald Araújo reality check Those in a position of power at La Liga giants Barcelona could be in for something of a rude awakening when it comes to their hopes of securing a big-money fee for on-loan defender Ronald Araújo next summer. This comes amid the understanding that Liverpool have no intention of coming even close to matching the agreed-upon purchase clause in the contract between the clubs. Stopper Araújo was of course granted something of a surprise loan exit from Barcelona over the summer, taking his talents to England with the aforementioned Liverpool. The 27-year-old has since proven himself a hit at Anfield, locking down the right-back spot in new boss Andoni Iraola’s XI, and endearing himself to the Reds faithful. Despite such ongoing excellence, though, the Uruguayan’s €55 million valuation at Barcelona remains a major point of contention on Merseyside. That’s according to Liverpool insider David Lynch, who, speaking on the ‘Media Matters’ podcast on Anfield Index (as cited by Diario Sport ) this week, explained: “I think it would be about half of the amount agreed upon in the purchase option.” That is to say, at present, Araújo’s loan club consider him to be worth a sum in the region of €27-28 million. Conor Laird – GSFN

item.title: Kyrie Irving Embraces Supporting Role Alongside Cooper Flagg but Makes One Thing Clear About His Own NBA Status
item.description: Kyrie Irving and Cooper Flagg © @dallasmavs/X Kyrie Irving gave Cooper Flagg high praise after the Dallas Mavericks’ 120-101 win over the Denver Nuggets. After years of being the spearhead of his teams, Irving is now trying to carve out a complementary role alongside Flagg, who is rapidly emerging as a franchise cornerstone and future superstar. “I’ve played with so many great players in this league. Seeing another young prodigy, a 19-year-old, go after superstardom, I feel like I’m a great complementary piece to that,” Irving said on NBA Showtime after the game. Irving said he knows exactly what his job is and what he brings to the table. “But I’m also established in this league myself. I don’t feel like a lot of people can guard me,” Irving added. The nine-time All-Star has been a stabilizing presence and, at times, a mentor to younger players, including Flagg, who burst onto the scene last year. While Irving missed the entire previous season with injuries, he’s now showing what he’s capable of. He’s averaging 22.0 points on 45.9% shooting in 14 games, while Flagg leads the team in points (24.3), assists (6.4) and steals (1.9). Flagg had another double-double against the Nuggets, finishing with 24 points, 12 assists and six rebounds. Irving, meanwhile, had an off night offensively, finishing with 11 points on 5-of-19 shooting from the field, including 1-of-8 from beyond the arc. Kyrie Irving’s Leadership Earns Praise From Hall of Famer Throughout his career, Kyrie Irving has played alongside some of the best players in NBA history. From winning a championship with LeBron James to reaching the NBA Finals with Luka Doncic, and now sharing the court with Cooper Flagg, Irving has experienced plenty of different team environments. Following the game, Hall of Famer Carmelo Anthony highlighted Irving’s ability to balance his leadership by being more vocal and leading by example. “I love to see this Kyrie. When you talk about the amount of work Kyrie puts into his craft, and someone who’s been there with him and spent summers with him. Understand the attention to detail that he has, he’s confrontational in the (summer) workouts, so I can imagine what he’s doing in the locker room with those guys, a younger group who doesn’t have the experience Kyrie has. I love when he said we’re confrontational. That’s not a bad thing, that’s just we’re putting everything out on the table, no side talk. We’re men at the end of the day, so if your whole locker room is operating like that, then it’s a beautiful locker room,” Anthony said via @MavsFilmRoom on X. It’s part of what makes Irving such an effective leader, and such communication is crucial to building team chemistry. Continually improving as individual players while developing stronger chemistry could help the Mavericks slowly but surely transition out of their rebuild over the next few seasons. Read More: Victor Wembanyama Tapped to Beat Luka Doncic to MVP Award as Eastern Conference Scout Explains His Choic

item.title: Cesc Fabregas quizzed on talk he could succeed Hansi Flick at Barcelona
item.description: Como's Spanish head coach Cesc Fabregas celebrates their victory at the end of the UEFA Champions League, league phase matchday 5, football match between Como 1907 and AEK Athens at the Stadio Giuseppe Sinigaglia in Como, northen Italy on November 24, 2026. (Photo by Stefano Rellandini / AFP via Getty Images) | AFP via Getty Images Cesc Fabregas has been quizzed on speculation he could head to Barcelona in the future and take over as the club’s manager. The former midfielder has been touted as a potential successor to Hansi Flick but doesn’t want to think too much about the future right now. “I’m one of those who live day to day. Thinking about the future usually doesn’t get you anywhere,” he told TNT Mexico. “I’m from there, I grew up at that club and I know all the people, but I’ve never liked thinking very far ahead. The times I have done it, it hasn’t gone well for me. Life is like piloting a plane that you never know when it brakes. That’s why we always have to try to enjoy ourselves. “When it’s time to compete, compete; when it’s time to enjoy, enjoy; when it’s time to be with family, be with family. I try to be a balanced person within the competitiveness and demands of being coach of a club like Como, where we are growing and I have so many responsibilities. “Enjoying it and knowing how to maintain the demands to keep growing at this club and, above all, at my job. But as I say, I focus on the day-to-day, because thinking about the future usually doesn’t get you anywhere,” he concluded on the matter.“ However, Fabregas did admit that he make sure to make time to watch Barcelona in action. “I don’t miss a single one. The other day we were preparing the game plan against AEK and I had it on my phone. My assistants had to tell me once: ‘Focus, it’s important,’” he explained. “But I really like football, and Barça plays at an incredible level, just like PSG or Bayern Munich. These four or five teams are amazing and I love seeing them.”

item.title: NASCAR Fans Angry at Trackhouse Over Bizarre Connor Zilisch’s New AI-Powered Race Car
item.description: IMAGN IMAGES via Reuters Connect Trackhouse Racing has found a way to make a NASCAR race car talk. Not through a driver on the radio or a crew chief explaining what is happening, but through artificial intelligence. The team’s new 88Bot gives Connor Zilisch’s No.88 Chevrolet its own personality, allowing users to ask questions and receive updates based on what is happening during a race. It is an ambitious technology project, but some fans aren’t exactly impressed. The reaction on X has been overwhelmingly negative. “This is so bad NASCAR needs to ban this,” one fan wrote. Another had a more direct suggestion for Trackhouse: “How about trying to make the cars faster?” Others questioned the idea altogether, with comments including “what are we even doing” and “wt* man.” It’s easy to see where the frustration comes from. Zilisch’s first full-time Cup season has been a rough one: 33rd in the 2026 standings, two top 10s and 10 DNFs. With that as the backdrop, plenty of fans would rather see Trackhouse put its energy into getting the car running better than into another tech showpiece. Trackhouse’s AI car can process 25,000 data messages per second May 10, 2026; Watkins Glen, New York, USA; Crew members push the car of NASCAR Cup Series driver Connor Zilisch (88) to pit road prior to the Go Bowling at The Glen at Watkins Glen International. Mandatory Credit: Matthew O’Haren-Imagn Images There’s a lot more to 88Bot than a chatbot pretending to be a race car. Trackhouse built it with digital design firm Very Good Ventures, and it runs on the same real-time data setup the team uses to process information from its cars during races. It can handle roughly 25,000 data messages per second, using live telemetry to answer questions and give updates. The AI is built to talk as if it’s the No.88 Chevrolet itself. It can tell you where it is, what’s going on around it and how the race is unfolding, rather than just reading out a list of stats. It also uses voice technology from LiveKit, and it was developed across the 2025 and 2026 seasons, with testing at events including Daytona and the Enjoy Illinois 300. The goal is to give guests a new way to follow the race. Instead of staring at a screen full of numbers, they can ask the car questions and get answers based on what’s happening on track. A VIP experience, not something every NASCAR fan gets The most frustrating thing about the project may be who it was built for. Trackhouse and Very Good Ventures have been working together on a digital experience for guests in the team’s pit box. The companion app, built with Flutter, pulls race information, telemetry, video and other team content together across multiple devices. 88Bot takes that a step further by letting guests talk to the car itself. That ties the project closely to corporate hospitality and the VIP experience. Very Good Ventures has also put out a browser-based version of 88Bot for the public, but the original pit-box setup is a different thing from some

item.title: ‘Not even close’ – NFL fans left shocked as list of first-time eligible HOF candidates shared
item.description: Photo by Nick Cammett/Getty Images The list of first-time eligible former players for the 2027 Pro Football Hall of Fame has been shared, with fans not overly convinced by some of the potential first-ballot additions. Hall of Fame candidates always seem to cause a stir among fans, with debates going on as to who should be inducted into the prestigious list of former players. This year is going to be no different, with some high-calibre former players entering the discussion. Ben Roethlisberger, Adrian Peterson, Rob Gronkowski, Antonio Brown and Richard Sherman are all eligible as potential first-time inductees. However, fans have been left debating their credentials online after the news broke on Tuesday. NFL fans debate first-time eligible former players in Hall of Fame nominations Gronkowski feels like an almost-automatic pick to be inducted into the Hall of Fame at the first opportunity. But the other names on the list have certainly sparked some controversy, with fans struggling to agree on who else should be inducted in 2027. ‘The people thinking Big Ben is a first-ballot hofer are delusional,’ said one fan on X. ‘AB has no chance. As much as I loved him as a player, he’d make a fool of himself while being inducted,’ replied another. Antonio Brown has certainly proven himself to be a controversial figure. Although one of the best wide receivers ever during his prime, the 38-year-old has been involved in a lot of controversies both on and off the field. ‘If T.O. couldn’t get first ballot no way they’ll allow AB,’ another fan added. ‘I feel like the only locks are Gronk and Peterson,’ said another. Earlier this year, there were only two first-ballot former players inducted into the Hall of Fame. Drew Brees and Larry Fitzgerald both made it into Canton at the very first opportunity following their extraordinary careers. ‘Sherman is not even close to a first-ballot HOFer,’ another NFL fan said on X. While another said: ‘Ben, AP and Gronk feel like easy calls. Antonio Brown is the one that’s going to make that voting room really uncomfortable.’ Read more: Who Stephen A. item.title: Wisconsin Linebacker Calls Gophers Dirty; Hates Everything About Minnesota
item.description: Matt Krohn-Imagn Images via Reuters Connect Paul Bunyan’s Axe has spent the last two years in Minnesota, where it belongs. That doesn’t sit well with those in Wisconsin, who haven’t seen the Axe around Madison as much since PJ Fleck took over as head coach of the Golden Gophers. Fleck enters Saturday’s game at Wisconsin with a 5-4 record as Minnesota head coach. The Gophers ( 6-5 , 4-4 Big Ten) have won two-straight against the Badgers (7-4, 5-3 Big Ten), and four of the last five. Minnesota is coming off a 20-17 win over Northwestern that made them bowl eligible, Wisconsin a 42-10 win at Purdue. Friday is the 136th game in the series, which the Gophers currently lead (barely) 64-63-8 . Mason Posa can’t stand the Minnesota Gophers There have been moments during this historic rivalry where both of these teams have absolutely hated each other. Of course, this is 2026, where NIL money and individual professional goals come before any antiquated football rivalries, right? Wrong, just ask Wisconsin linebacker Mason Posa, who met with reporters in Madison on Tuesday. There, the sophomore linebacker laid out his hatred for the University of Minnesota and just what this game means to him. Spoiler : It’s a lot. The Sophomore linebacker told reporters Tuesday that he has been losing legitimate sleep thinking about this game, and that he can’t stand the Gophers or anything about Minnesota. “It means everything to me… this is a team I can’t stand, I hate looking at them, I hate hearing their name.” Badgers LB Mason Posa on what Axe Week means to him and his feelings toward Minnesota. — Riley Jauch (@rileyjauch) November 24, 2026 “Yeah, no, it means everything to me. I’m kind of losing sleep a little bit just thinking about the game. I really want to beat these guys.” “This is a team I can’t stand. I hate looking at them. I hate hearing their name.” “It’s gonna be a fun game to play. And they’re a good football team too. They got good players. They’ve had some really good games, some close games, and they could come at us any other way. So we gotta be prepared, and I’m just really excited to play.” Mason Posa – ESPN Madison Related: Struggling Gophers RB Planning to Return? Posa, from Albuquerque, N.M., was named a finalist for the Butkus Award on Nov. 20. He’s the first Badger to be a finalist for the award since Leo Chenal in 2021, and he’s also a Bednarik Award semifinalist. Last season, he was an FWAA Freshman All-American and a third-team All-Big Ten pick by the coaches. As a freshman last November, Posa had 9 tackles , 6 of them solo, in Wisconsin’s 17-7 loss in Minneapolis. It’s the only time he has played against the Gophers. Posa says Gopher players are dirty That wasn’t the only Posa + Minnesota clip to hit the internet yesterday. Posa continued by telling reporters that there’s a lot he’d like to say but can’t. item.title: Gio Garbelini on Brazil squad competition: “Helps us grow and improve”
item.description: Gio Garbelini on Brazil squad competition: “Helps us grow and improve” The Brazil Women’s National Team held their first training session in Hiroshima, Japan, on Wednesday afternoon (25) at Hot Staff Field. Brazil will face the hosts twice, and head coach Arthur Elias has called up 10 forwards for this final FIFA international window of 2026, including Gio Garbelini. The Atlético de Madrid player spoke about the competition among the players and how it benefits the squad. “We have a lot of forwards in this squad, and I think that’s very positive. There’s a lot of competition, and that helps us grow and improve. We trust our work and always want to do what we do best. We’re a very direct team, and we like to press high to make our opponents fear us. There’s always a risk at the back, but we have a lot of confidence in our work,” she said. One of the topics Gio discussed was her relationship with Arthur Elias. The forward said the coach has contributed greatly to her development and that there is a strong sense of trust between him and the players. “Since Arthur first called me up, I’ve improved a lot and learned a great deal from him. The confidence he gives me and the other players is very important,” she said. Gio during Brazil’s training session in Hiroshima Credits: Luciana Vermell/CBF Brazil will face Japan in two friendlies. The first match will take place on November 29 at Edion Peace Wing Stadium in Hiroshima, at 1:55 a.m. Brasília time. The second will be on December 5 at JFE Harenokuni Stadium in Okayama, at 3 a.m. Brasília time. Alongside Gio, Luany has also been called up for Brazil’s final matches of the year. Both play for Atlético de Madrid, and their partnership is evident on and off the pitch. Gio shared how their friendship began and highlighted her club and national team teammate’s cheerful personality. “When I left Arsenal and moved to Madrid, Luany was already there. I didn’t know her, but we built this friendship off the pitch. She’s really nice and always so cheerful. On the pitch, we’ve also developed that connection, understanding each other and working hard for one another, and that helps both at our club and with the national team.” Watch the press conference: This article was translated into English by Artificial Intelligence. item.title: Pittsburgh Steelers Make Stunning Decision on Aaron Rodgers
item.description: One of the greatest quarterbacks in NFL history may have played his final snap, and it certainly isn’t the way he envisioned going out. Late Tuesday night , the Pittsburgh Steelers announced via X that Aaron Rodgers will be inactive for Friday’s matchup against the Denver Broncos, with veteran backup Mason Rudolph taking over as the starting quarterback. The decision comes just one day after Steelers head coach Mike McCarthy publicly backed Rodgers, telling reporters that the four-time NFL MVP remained the team’s quarterback. According to ESPN’s Brooke Pryor, the decision to bench Rodgers was performance-related rather than injury-related. For Detroit Lions fans who spent years watching Rodgers torment the NFC North as quarterback of the Green Bay Packers, it is a remarkable development. Rodgers, who will turn 43 next week, previously announced that the 2026 season would be his last in the NFL. Nov 22, 2026; Philadelphia, Pennsylvania, USA; Pittsburgh Steelers quarterback Aaron Rodgers (8) reacts after the game at Lincoln Financial Field. Mandatory Credit: Eric Hartline-Imagn Images Credit: IMAGN IMAGES via Reuters Connect (Reuters) Aaron Rodgers’ Struggles Force Pittsburgh’s Hand The numbers suggest Pittsburgh’s decision was more than a knee-jerk reaction to consecutive losses. Rodgers has completed just 60.9% of his passes this season while taking 31 sacks, resulting in an NFL-worst 257 yards lost. Perhaps even more concerning is Rodgers’ declining accuracy. His 18.9% off-target rate ranks 28th among 30 qualified NFL quarterbacks, a stunning statistic for a player whose pinpoint accuracy helped make him one of the most dangerous passers in league history. The irony is that Rodgers helped bring McCarthy to Pittsburgh, recommending that general manager Omar Khan consider his former Packers head coach during the team’s coaching search. Now, the coach who helped Rodgers become a superstar in Green Bay is the same man making the decision to take him out of the starting lineup. Has Aaron Rodgers Played His Final NFL Snap? That is now the biggest question surrounding Rodgers, whose future could depend on how Rudolph performs down the stretch. Rudolph previously demonstrated his ability to provide Pittsburgh with an offensive spark, winning three consecutive games as the team’s starter to close out the 2023 regular season. Rodgers spent much of his career making life miserable for Lions fans, but there is no denying what he accomplished during his 22-year NFL career. Four MVP awards, a Super Bowl championship and a virtually guaranteed spot in the Pro Football Hall of Fame speak for themselves. Every legendary quarterback eventually reaches the end of the road. For Rodgers, that moment may have arrived sooner than he anticipated.

item.title: Cristiano Ronaldo’s rival manager shares honest thoughts on his international farewell
item.description: Cristiano Ronaldo’s rival manager shares honest thoughts on his international farewell appeared first on ClutchPoints . Add ClutchPoints as a Preferred Source by clicking here . Earlier this year, just a few weeks after Lionel Messi’s international retirement , his rival Cristiano Ronaldo also announced his international retirement . After a miscommunication with new Portugal manager Jorge Jesus, Ronaldo left the national camp amid the team’s UEFA Nations League campaign. He later accepted punishment for his behavior, before announcing his decision to step down from international soccer. While Lionel Messi received a major international farewell game, Ronaldo has yet to receive one. However, it should also be noted that there hasn’t been any chatter about Ronaldo actually receiving one. Recently, speaking on RomárioTV, former FC Barcelona and Manchester City manager Pep Guardiola opened up about Ronaldo’s international retirement and claimed that the legend deserves a proper farewell. Watch sports LIVE with fuboTV (free trial) “The Portuguese Football Federation must ensure a dignified end to Cristiano Ronaldo’s career. Both sides need to make an effort to guarantee a fitting farewell. Cristiano Ronaldo shouldn’t leave the Portuguese national team in this manner. “They can’t let him go like this. He’s been an incredibly important figure, not only for himself and Portugal, but for future generations of Portuguese players. They must understand that Cristiano Ronaldo deserves to leave on his own terms. There are exceptional players, and Cristiano Ronaldo is one of them; therefore, this situation must be rectified”. “Whether they rectify it or not isn’t my concern, but they absolutely must. That’s right; what he’s achieved in the world of football deserves a different ending. There should be a celebration where he feels the love of his countrymen, and he, in turn, must also take the initiative and say: Let’s turn the page on the past. An entire career shouldn’t be judged based on a month or two, or because of a disagreement or misunderstanding with one or two individuals”. “There are careers filled with achievements that deserve to be preserved and defended. Great players, those who were truly at the pinnacle of their game, deserve to leave through the front door. Firstly, because they earned it through everything they gave to the sport; football itself owes them this recognition”. “And secondly, for the sake of the children taking their first steps on the pitch, who might say: I want to end my career like Romário, Cristiano Ronaldo, Lionel Messi, Paolo Maldini, or any of the other greats throughout history. That’s how it should be,” he said. (via Fabrizio Romano) Guardiola managed Barcelona and Manchester City , while Ronaldo was an integral part of both the team’s rival clubs, Real Madrid and Manchester United. item.title: What Texas football's No. 3 CFP ranking means for Week 13, possible title game vs Georgia
item.description: Texas Longhorns quarterback Arch Manning (16) is sacked during the game against Georgia at Sanford Stadium on Saturday, Nov. 15, 2025 in Athens, Georgia. (Aaron E. Martinez/Austin American-Statesman) Texas football finally has breathing room in its chase for one of the 12 College Football Playoff spots. The No. 3 Longhorns (9-2, 6-2 SEC) have more wins (five) over then-top 25 teams than any team in the nation. Texas is very likely set to be a playoff team even with a loss Friday to Texas A&M , though a third loss would be ugly given the Longhorns will enter College Station as nearly two-touchdown favorites. There will be little drama regarding Texas' potential inclusion in the playoff. A more intriguing question still looms over Texas' seeding and potential first-round bye. How can the Longhorns remain a top-four seed during Selection Sunday on Dec. 6? These are their most plausible paths. PLAYOFF PUSH: Texas pounds Arkansas in home finale. Will the Longhorns play again in Austin this year? FAMOUS FACES: James Talarico fires cannon at today's game, Gov. Abbott attends, too How Texas can win its way to a top-four seed Here's a simple route for the Longhorns to secure a top-four seed in the CFP: beat Texas A&M, advance to the SEC championship game in Atlanta (still uncertain as of Wednesday), then beat Georgia. Texas is 0-3 against Georgia in the Steve Sarkisian era. It would likely be a touchdown-or-so underdog against the Bulldogs. But the risk of adding a third loss also comes with the opportunity of knocking off the No. 1 team in the nation. Doing so would likely vault Texas to at least No. 2 behind Utah, or potentially the playoff's No. 1 seed, an outcome unthinkable after back-to-back losses in October. SEC tiebreakers: What game should Texas fans be watching this week? The crowded SEC tiebreaker among Texas, Tennessee and Alabama is actually contingent upon several different games, because strength of opponents' record is considered and that won't be finalized until Saturday night. But to put it most simply, Longhorns fans should be on the lookout for a few games Friday and a few games Saturday. Chief among them will be the results of No. 5 Tennessee at Vanderbilt and Auburn at No. 6 Alabama late Saturday. If Texas wins and either of those teams lose, the Longhorns will play Georgia in the title game Dec. 5. But it could all be over before the Crimson Tide and Volunteers take the field Saturday night. If Texas beats A&M and No. 22 Ole Miss, the favorite in the Egg Bowl, beats injury-depleted Mississippi State on Friday at home, the Longhorns are in the championship game. Mississippi State wins as 19½-point underdog? Then an LSU loss at Arkansas early Saturday clinches Texas a date with Georgia (the Tigers are favored by 14½). Should Texas lose the Lone Star Showdown, there's virtually no way it can make the title game - even with Tennessee and Alabama losses. There's only one way for Texas to win Week 13 and miss the title game. More on that

item.title: How the Denver Broncos shockingly reacted to Aaron Rodgers being benched by the Steelers, according to Mike Florio
item.description: Photo by Emilee Chinn/Getty Images Aaron Rodgers has been benched by the Pittsburgh Steelers in a surprise late night move announced by the team. The Aaron Rodgers era with the Pittsburgh Steelers could be at an end after the team confirmed Mason Rudolph would be taking over as a starter. Rodgers, 42, had been visibly and audibly frustrated with the team’s performances in their past two defeats against the Bengals and Eagles. The Steelers are set to face the Denver Broncos on Friday night, and according to Pro Football Talk’s Mike Florio, there has been a very mixed reaction to the news from from their upcoming opponents. Florio revealed: “From the Broncos’ perspective, I’ve already heard that their reaction to this news is they don’t know whether it’s good or bad. It could be bad news. “The Steelers’ offense could be better off with Mason Rudolph, that’s how far it’s fallen under Aaron Rodgers.” Florio’s comments are a damning indictment on the state of the Steelers’ right now under Rodgers, with the Broncos fearing that Pittsburgh could actually be more dangerous with Mason Rudolph. Rudolph has a 8-5-1 record as a starter for the Steelers, plus a 1-4 record as a starter during his stint at the Titans. He is 9-9-1 across his career. Rodgers won’t want to go out like this Mike Florio believes Aaron Rodgers could eventually get waived by the Steelers, and this could open up the possibility of signing for another team for a playoff run. “When the waivers expire, he doesn’t want anyone else to claim him. He wants to be able to pick his next spot. He becomes a potentially intriguing option if a contender has a starter injured down the stretch. “I don’t know that Rodgers is going to go anywhere and be the number two. I don’t know that he’s wired to accept that. “I think what he would just do is sit back, wait, and if it happens, and the phone rings, and he sees a path to playing for a contender and having a chance to get to the playoffs and make some noise in the postseason, that’s when he’d be inclined to do it. “He doesn’t want his career to end this way.” The Steelers are currently 6-4 for the season, only one game behind the 7-3 AFC North leaders, Cincinnati Bengals.
